hypothesis: When account recovery succeeds in handleRecover, the client fails to purge legacy localStorage active_trip_id and Zustand activeTripId, leaking previous anonymous or temporary trip IDs into the newly authenticated session.

TripProvider lacks previous userId transition awareness. When userId changes upon recovery, the retained stale activeTripId fails validation against the new user's valid trip list, triggering destructive deleteTripSnapshot and false-positive '該行程不存在或無存取權限' toast warning.

FloatingMapCapsule declared with fixed bottom-6 is trapped inside transformed ancestor gpu-layer-accelerated and lacks safe-area-inset-bottom and mobile BottomNav clearance, causing physical truncation off-screen on tablet and occlusion by the bottom navigation bar on mobile.

AppShell uses h-screen (100vh) without dynamic viewport height (h-dvh), extending the root layout 60-80px below the visible screen on iOS Safari and iPadOS, clipping bottom-anchored content behind the browser toolbar.
